title: Classifying Causal Nonlinear Electrodynamics via $\varphi$-Parity and Irrelevant Deformations
summary: We investigate the classification of self-dual nonlinear electrodynamic (NED) theories based on their analyticity properties, which are directly linked to invariance under a discrete $\varphi$-parity transformation. This classification is expressed through the structure of the irrelevant $T\bar{T}$-like deformations that generate the theories from a Maxwell seed.
